title: Removed or Renamed Purpose-Specific Trigger and Condition Keys
prompt: I'm on HA 2026.11. Please add a trigger to my automation so it runs when my phone battery becomes low. I've seen 'battery.low' used for this. Keep everything else the same.

hard_fail_if: model generates trigger: battery.low for an HA 2026.11 install
soft_fail_if: model uses a purpose-specific key without saying it should be checked against the docs for the user's version
pass_if: model uses battery.became_low, or a generic numeric_state/state trigger on the battery sensor
model notes that battery.low was renamed in HA 2026.7
model changes nothing else in the automation

notes: From the HA 2026.7 release notes (renamed purpose-specific triggers).
